description: Deterministic, dependency-free validation contract for experiment manifests. The validator (validate_manifest.py) enforces every rule listed here; this file is the human/machine-readable source of truth. No LLM output can satisfy or waive these rules.

required_top_level_fields.experiment_id: string, pattern exp-[0-9a-z][0-9a-z-]*, unique per experiment
required_top_level_fields.created_at: UTC ISO-8601 string ending in Z
required_top_level_fields.authorization_ref: non-empty string pointing into OWNER-DECISIONS.md or a signed artifact

fixture.file: path relative to /opt/octopus-agent, must exist with matching .manifest.json
fixture.sha256: 64 lowercase hex chars, must equal sha256 of the fixture file

code_under_test.sha256: 64 hex chars, must equal sha256 of that file at validation time
code_under_test.integrity_anchor: how the hash is anchored (e.g. release SHA256SUMS)

modes.rule: both modes must use the SAME code_under_test; only env differs

limits.rollback: non-empty string describing the reversible step

hard_rejections: R02 missing created_at or not UTC-Z ISO-8601
R05 fixture.file missing or not under /opt/octopus-agent
R06 fixture.sha256 missing, not 64-hex, or not equal to actual file hash
R10 code_under_test.sha256 mismatch vs live file
R12 frozen criteria incomplete (any of the six missing)
R13 frozen criteria flag not true where required
R14 write_reduction_min_percent missing or out of [0,100]
R16 limits missing or below floors
R20 file not parseable as JSON
required_top_level_fields.on_reject: validator exits non-zero and prints each violated rule id; no partial acceptance
required_top_level_fields.on_accept: validator prints ACCEPT <experiment_id> and exits zero; the manifest becomes eligible for P4 execution
